responsibility: This definition module declares mc’s pretty-printing abstraction used for generated output. It defines the pretty handle plus operations for indentation control, cursor-position tracking, stacked temporary formatting contexts, deferred space insertion, and translated or raw string emission, forming the interface used by decl and keyc when writing C, C++, or Modula-2 text.
same_name_distinction: This .def file is the abstract interface for the mcPretty formatter, declaring the opaque pretty handle and operations for indentation, spacing, stacking, and output. mcPretty.mod supplies the concrete record layout and behavior behind those calls.
